formation.title: Company incorporation & international structuring
formation.intro: A company is part of a wider business structure. We advise on formation, ownership and jurisdiction choices in the context of where you intend to operate.
scope: Company formation
Formation support across the US, UK, UAE, Singapore, India, BVI, Cayman and Seychelles, with jurisdiction-specific scope discussed for your business.
Holding companies & SPVs
Structures for ownership, investment and defined business activities, considered alongside your wider group.
International structuring
Jurisdiction advisory and offshore structuring, with corporate, banking and operational requirements considered together.
prepare: What the business will do and where its customers will be.
Where founders and decision-makers are based.
Planned ownership, fundraising and banking requirements.
questions: Can you help us choose a jurisdiction?
Jurisdiction advisory is part of the service. The conversation starts with your activities, ownership and operating markets, rather than a preselected country.
Is this only for new companies?
The scope also includes holding companies, SPVs and international structures. Share your existing structure if you are considering a change.

regulation.title: Web3, crypto & fintech regulation
regulation.intro: Regulatory questions are inseparable from how a financial product works. We advise on the business model, relevant markets and legal requirements behind digital finance.
scope: Regulatory scope & legal opinions
Advice concerning crypto, fintech, DeFi, exchanges, derivatives and prediction markets, including legal opinions where appropriate to the engagement.
VASP licensing
Licensing advisory shaped around the proposed activities and relevant jurisdictions.
AML/KYC & compliance
Advice on anti-money laundering, customer verification and regulatory compliance for the business and its operating model.
prepare: A short product description and the users it serves.
The countries in which you operate or intend to launch.
How assets and payments move through the product.
questions: What should we share about the product?
A product overview, customer journey and asset-flow diagram provide a useful starting point. Include any existing licences or regulatory correspondence.
Can this include a legal opinion?
Legal opinions are within the stated service scope. The question to be addressed, intended use and relevant jurisdictions need to be discussed first.

platform.title: App Store & technology compliance
platform.intro: An app’s product design, financial features and legal structure need to be considered together. We support businesses working through platform policies, reviews and rejection appeals.
scope: Platform policy review
Advice on Apple App Store and Google Play requirements, including policies relevant to financial apps.
Rejection appeals
Support with the legal and regulatory aspects of responding to app rejection notices and platform correspondence.
Product structuring
Consideration of the product’s features, business structure and platform regulatory requirements before or during review.
prepare: Your app description and the features under review.
The original rejection notice and subsequent correspondence.
Launch markets, company details and relevant legal documents.
questions: Can we approach you before submitting an app?
Yes. The service includes platform compliance and product structuring, as well as rejection appeals.
What helps when an app has already been rejected?
Share the exact notice, review history and the version or features involved. These give the discussion a concrete starting point.

governance.title: Corporate governance & legal documentation
governance.intro: Clear corporate records and well-considered agreements support the decisions a business makes every day. We advise on governance, company changes and commercial documentation.
scope: Corporate governance
Corporate compliance, director and shareholder changes, bylaws and company resolutions.
Commercial agreements
Commercial contracts and NDAs, considered in the context of the transaction and business relationship.
Ownership & user terms
Shareholder agreements and Terms of Service, alongside the wider documentation needs of the company.
prepare: The company jurisdiction and current ownership structure.
The decision, transaction or relationship requiring support.
Existing agreements, constitutional documents and relevant deadlines.
questions: Can you review existing documents?
Share the documents and explain the decision or transaction they relate to. The review scope can then be discussed around the specific matter.
Does this include director or shareholder changes?
Director and shareholder changes, resolutions and corporate compliance are included in the stated service scope.

banking.title: Banking, payments & tax advisory
banking.intro: Corporate structures need practical banking and payment arrangements. We advise on onboarding, payment infrastructure and tax compliance in the context of cross-border operations.
scope: Banking & onboarding
Corporate banking assistance and payment gateway onboarding, with the company’s activities and documentation considered together.
Payment infrastructure
Advice concerning payment infrastructure, cross-border payments and the way funds move through the business.
Tax advisory & compliance
Crypto taxation and corporate tax compliance, with the relevant business structure and jurisdictions identified at the outset.
prepare: Company details, ownership and operating jurisdictions.
Your payment flows, currencies and customer markets.
Current banking arrangements and the specific tax or onboarding issue.
questions: What information is useful for onboarding support?
Company and ownership documents, a description of activities and an outline of transaction flows are useful starting materials.
Can banking and tax questions be discussed together?
Both are within the service scope. Describe the whole operating structure so the relevant questions can be identified together.

startup.title: Startup & investment advisory
startup.intro: Funding decisions affect ownership, governance and the next stage of the business. We support startups with fundraising documents, equity structures and investment arrangements.
scope: Fundraising documentation
Support with fundraising documents, including SAFE and SAFT agreements, in the context of the proposed round.
Equity structuring
Advice on equity structures and ownership arrangements for the company and its stakeholders.
Investment vehicles & support
Investment vehicles and continuing startup legal support as the business develops.
prepare: The company’s stage and existing ownership structure.
The intended round, proposed investment and key terms.
Current agreements, cap table and any investor documentation.
questions: When is it useful to involve legal counsel?
An initial discussion can focus on the proposed round, ownership structure and documents already in circulation.
Can support extend beyond a funding round?
The service scope includes continuing startup legal support as well as fundraising documents and investment structures.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.intro: A brand, creative work or commercial agreement can carry lasting value. We support businesses with trademark registration, copyright, brand protection and IP agreements.
scope: Trademark registration
Support with trademark registration for the brand and the jurisdictions relevant to the business.
Copyright & brand protection
Advice concerning copyright and the protection of business identity and creative work.
IP agreements
Intellectual property agreements connected to ownership, use and commercial relationships.
prepare: The name, brand or work you want to protect.
Relevant markets and any existing registrations or applications.
Ownership information and agreements concerning the IP.
questions: What should we share about the brand?
The proposed or existing name, associated products or services, target markets and any prior applications provide a useful starting point.
Does the service include agreements?
Yes. Intellectual property agreements are part of the stated scope, alongside registration and brand protection.

disputes.title: Legal notices & dispute resolution
disputes.intro: A clear account of the facts and correspondence is the starting point for a dispute. We support businesses with legal notices, platform disputes and pre-litigation advisory.
scope: Legal notices
Advice and support concerning legal notices and the correspondence surrounding a business dispute.
Platform disputes
Support with platform disputes and regulatory representations, shaped around the issue and relevant documents.
Pre-litigation advisory
Advice before litigation, considering the specific matter, available information and the business context.
prepare: A brief chronology, key dates and the issue requiring attention.
Relevant contracts, notices and correspondence.
The parties involved and the outcome you are seeking.
questions: What should we send before the first discussion?
A short chronology and the original correspondence are useful. Highlight any deadlines already stated in notices or agreements.
Is this service limited to court proceedings?
The stated scope includes legal notices, platform disputes, regulatory representations and pre-litigation advisory.
